---
title: "Events Calendar"
format:
  html:
    toc: false
---

Stay updated on data science education events, workshops, and conferences.

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

import yaml
from datetime import datetime, date
from pathlib import Path
from IPython.display import display, HTML, Markdown

# Load events data
events_file = Path("../_data/events.yml")
with open(events_file, "r") as f:
    data = yaml.safe_load(f)

events = data.get("events", [])

# Parse dates and sort
for event in events:
    event["date_obj"] = datetime.strptime(event["date"], "%Y-%m-%d").date()
    if event.get("end_date"):
        event["end_date_obj"] = datetime.strptime(event["end_date"], "%Y-%m-%d").date()
    else:
        event["end_date_obj"] = None

today = date.today()

# Split into upcoming and past
upcoming = [e for e in events if e["date_obj"] >= today or (e.get("end_date_obj") and e["end_date_obj"] >= today)]
past = [e for e in events if e["date_obj"] < today and (not e.get("end_date_obj") or e["end_date_obj"] < today)]

# Sort upcoming by date (soonest first), past by date (most recent first)
upcoming.sort(key=lambda x: x["date_obj"])
past.sort(key=lambda x: x["date_obj"], reverse=True)

# Category colors (WCAG AA contrast with white text)
category_colors = {
    "conference": "#1a365d",
    "workshop": "#1e6f30",
    "webinar": "#553c9a",
    "meetup": "#8b4513",
    "hackathon": "#9b2c2c",
    "other": "#4a5568"
}

def format_date(event):
    d = event["date_obj"]
    formatted = d.strftime("%B %d, %Y")
    if event.get("end_date_obj"):
        end = event["end_date_obj"]
        if d.month == end.month and d.year == end.year:
            formatted = f"{d.strftime('%B %d')} - {end.strftime('%d, %Y')}"
        else:
            formatted = f"{d.strftime('%B %d, %Y')} - {end.strftime('%B %d, %Y')}"
    return formatted

def render_event(event, is_past=False):
    cat = event.get("category", "other")
    color = category_colors.get(cat, category_colors["other"])
    past_class = "event-past" if is_past else ""

    link_html = ""
    if event.get("link"):
        link_html = f'<a href="{event["link"]}" class="event-link">Learn more →</a>'

    month = event["date_obj"].strftime("%b").upper()
    day = event["date_obj"].strftime("%d")

    return f'''<div class="event-card {past_class}">
<div class="event-date-badge" style="background-color: {color};">
<span class="event-month">{month}</span>
<span class="event-day">{day}</span>
</div>
<div class="event-content">
<h3 class="event-title">{event["title"]}</h3>
<div class="event-meta">
<span class="event-date-full">{format_date(event)}</span>
<span class="event-time">{event.get("time", "TBD")}</span>
<span class="event-location">{event.get("location", "TBD")}</span>
</div>
<p class="event-description">{event.get("description", "")}</p>
{link_html}
</div>
</div>'''

# Build HTML output
html_output = []

html_output.append("## Upcoming Events\n")

if upcoming:
    html_output.append('<div class="events-timeline">')
    for event in upcoming:
        html_output.append(render_event(event, is_past=False))
    html_output.append('</div>')
else:
    html_output.append("""
::: {.callout-note}
No upcoming events scheduled. Check back soon for updates!
:::
""")

html_output.append("\n## Past Events\n")

if past:
    html_output.append('<div class="events-timeline events-past-section">')
    for event in past:
        html_output.append(render_event(event, is_past=True))
    html_output.append('</div>')
else:
    html_output.append("*No past events to display.*\n")

html_output.append("\n---\n")
html_output.append("*Want to share information about an upcoming event? Contact us at [ds-help@berkeley.edu](mailto:ds-help@berkeley.edu).*")

# Display as Markdown which allows raw HTML
display(Markdown("\n".join(html_output)))
```
